astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Peculiar Elliptical Galaxy Centaurus A
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What's happened to the center of this galaxy?  Dramatic dust lanes run across the center of unusual elliptical galaxy Centaurus A. These dust lanes are so thick they almost completely obscure the galaxy's center in visible light.
